raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted “the city the winner is from” as the winner’s birthplace (Omaha) instead of his residence/hometown (Austin). This led the reasoning down the wrong path (asserting no year) and later compounded by confusing “capitol” (building) with “capital” (city). The correct interpretation leads to Austin, which became the capital of Texas in 1839.
